name: Grim Servant
clause: When ~ enters, search your library for a card with mana value less than or equal to your devotion to black, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. You lose 3 life.

needs.semantics: Your devotion to the listed colours: the number of mana symbols of those colours in the mana costs of permanents you control.
needs.clause: a card with mana value less than or equal to your devotion to black
